startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to convert and start crawling from.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages were converted. You are charged per converted page.

maxDepth.title: Max link depth
maxDepth.description: 0 = only the start URLs, 1 = also pages they link to, and so on.

sameHostOnly.title: Stay on the same host
sameHostOnly.description: Only follow links on the hosts of the start URLs.

useSitemap.title: Seed from sitemap.xml
useSitemap.description: Also queue the URLs listed in the site's sitemap (found via robots.txt or /sitemap.xml). Best way to cover a whole docs site.

includeUrlGlobs.title: Include URL patterns
includeUrlGlobs.description: Only crawl URLs matching one of these glob patterns, e.g. https://example.com/docs/*. Empty = all.

excludeUrlGlobs.title: Exclude URL patterns
excludeUrlGlobs.description: Skip URLs matching these glob patterns, e.g. *login* or */tag/*.

keepLinks.title: Keep hyperlinks in Markdown
keepLinks.description: Turn off for plainer text, which saves tokens.

saveHtml.title: Also save raw HTML
saveHtml.description: Add the original HTML of each page to the output item.

delaySecs.title: Delay between requests to one host (seconds)
delaySecs.description: Politeness delay. A larger Crawl-delay in robots.txt wins.
